title: Carthago private R102 candidate provenance sidecar — proposed schema version 2
description: PARKED / NOT IMPLEMENTED. Structural allowlist for locally staged, unapproved V2 R102 provenance; separate from the Holdout V2 manifest's schemaVersion=2 and existing importer provenance schemaVersion=1. Passing this schema is NEVER evidence approval.

sourceKind.description: Legacy sourceKind token maintained for manifest compatibility; NOT proof of approval.

sourceUri.description: Syntactic HTTPS only. Never establishes license rights, source ownership, reviewer identity or independence.

sourceLicenseEvidenceUri.description: Syntactic HTTPS only. Never establishes license rights, source ownership, reviewer identity or independence.

independentLabelBasis.description: Untrusted assertion pending independent human verification.

analystReviewedLabel.description: Typed declaration only; true is NOT proof that review happened.

capturedTransportEvidence.description: Must be verified against original source frames; cannot be trusted as a claim.

frameNumbers.description: Repeated frame numbers allowed only when questionIndices differ; composite uniqueness checked by runtime.

questionIndices.description: Zero-based DNS question ordinal. Runtime must check exact count, per-frame bounds and uniqueness of each frame/ordinal pair.

sourceAddress.description: Structural shape only; runtime must parse using System.Net.IPAddress and check actual captured source.

queryRoot.description: Legacy printable grouping root; never a lossless DNS wire-label oracle.

originatingClientLabel.description: Opaque local private identity, not independently verified by syntax.

collectionSessionId.description: Opaque local private identity, not independently verified by syntax.

collectionVantage.description: A sensor vantage does not establish independent clients.

independentClientEvidenceUri.description: Syntactic HTTPS only. Never establishes license rights, source ownership, reviewer identity or independence.

dnsWireNameEncoding.description: Private byte-accurate decoding required, but reversible wire labels are intentionally excluded from default JSON provenance and telemetry.

transformations.const: None: original DNS label octets preserved; ASCII-only identity comparison

reviewState.description: This file cannot approve source license, classification, independent client or V2 freeze.

$comment: Cross-field count equality; unique (captureHash,frameNumber,questionIndex); actual capture hash, IP, transport, QTYPE and DNS wire bytes; 2 benign+2 malicious slots; session/origin independence; reviewer authenticity; licensing rights; and atomic publication MUST be verified outside JSON Schema. Schema matching is never admission.
